defaultDesc: Show the note-optimisation disclaimer again without restarting the game.

Ultimate extreme-chart switch. When ON, botplay is forced and locked, high-density note sections use precomputed aggregation plus data-level bulk settlement instead of materializing tens of thousands of sprites. When OFF, everything is exactly the stock behavior.

Maximum materialized notes at once. 0 means unlimited (only for high-end machines).
Higher values render more notes but cost more CPU/GPU and memory.

H-Slice style faster sort: only visible/alive notes are sorted every frame.
Improves frame time on dense charts; turn off if a mod depends on the full group order.

H-Slice style bulk skipping of already expired chart notes.
Avoids spawn->instant miss churn on extreme NPS charts.
Requires Performance Mode; auto-disabled while Lua/HScript/replay/online is active.

Keeps the note list of very large charts (64 MB and up) on disk, so re-entering the song
skips parsing, folding and sorting it again. Only charts that already load through the
streaming reader are affected; turning this off always reads the chart file from scratch.

Deflates the cached note list in 1 MB blocks. The same list measured 290 MB plain
and 2 MB compressed, at the cost of about one extra second per load and per save.
Turn this off for the fastest possible load if the disk usage does not bother you.

Press ENTER to delete every cached chart note list. Do it after editing a chart in place:
an edited chart is detected by its size and timestamp, but a tool that preserves both
would leave the old note list in use.
